The Week Ahead · The Week

Defense and aviation added $634 million alone. The same industrial expansion driving these numbers also produced the Soma mine death and Üsküdar worker layoffs, according to connecting reports. Meanwhile, SPK extended margin requirements for leveraged trading as car payments exceed affordability thresholds. Exporters gain; households face tighter credit. State accountability is also in focus. Google will respond to Turkish users within 30 days on data handling. Rojin Kabaiş's father marked two years since her death, demanding the state identify her killers. The Istanbul Bar pressed the Justice Ministry on journalist Mehmet Pehlivan. SPK rules take effect immediately.

Defense, aviation exports hit $634M in September

aa.com.tr · 3 Oct 2026

Türkiye's defense and aviation sector exported $634 million worth of goods in September, according to industry data carried by state media

The $634 million figure covers the full defense and aviation industry's September export total. The sector has been a growing pillar of Türkiye's industrial output. The number reflects ongoing contracts with domestic and foreign buyers. The defense industry has been a central part of the government's industrial policy in recent years. No breakdown by product or destination was provided in the report.

September exports reached $634M for defense and aviation. This supports the sector employing workers in Kocaeli's industrial zones.

Turkish banks pay up to 15,000 TRY for pension transfers this October

news.google.com · 3 Oct 2026

Garanti, İş Bankası, Ziraat, and Yapı Kredi are running emekli promosyonu campaigns in October 2026. A one-time cash payment lands when a pensioner moves their monthly salary to the bank

The emekli promosyonu is a one-time cash bonus paid by Turkish banks to social-security pensioners who transfer their monthly pension deposit to that bank. Bigpara and Uzmanpara both published updated October 2026 lists naming Garanti, İş Bankası, Ziraat, and Yapı Kredi as active. Amounts vary by bank and by the pensioner's monthly salary bracket. The payment is a single lump sum, not a monthly rebate. No source in this feed confirms the exact October 2026 figures, so treat the range as unverified. A pensioner in İzmit can walk into any of the four banks with a T.C. kimlik and a

  • Amount scales with the pensioner's monthly salary bracket

The Editorial

Export targets are met three months early. That is a fact. It does not mean the factory floor is safe. The same reports linking defense exports to the Soma mine death and Üsküdar layoffs show the cost of this speed. Workers pay in accidents and cuts. Households pay in credit rules and car payments. The state asks exporters to deliver and citizens to absorb. We print the numbers, but we also print the receipts. Read the SPK rules before you trade. Check the pension promo terms before you transfer. Facts first.

— The Editor, Teşkilat-ı Düzen

Colophon & Method

Lens & Facts — how this paper chooses and frames

Selection, questions and framing are governed by an energy-literate scientific materialism and a dialectical method — facts are not. Every factual claim carries a source; the lens never alters a number, date or quote; a claim that contradicts the lens is reported, not suppressed. Settled evidence is called settled with citations; genuinely contested positions both appear with their evidence. News summaries, analysis and opinion are visually distinct, and analysis always reads through the lens. The machine audits itself in public: errors are corrected openly, and periodic "stories that broke our frame" exercises use the lens's own tools to test its default narrative. Funding, cost and conflicts are disclosed here, in the State of the Machine.

Coverage spans the region and the world. Opportunities are judged by a simple test: can a working person actually act on this, and does it improve their real conditions or their community's? Anything that gates its benefit behind money, status or existing wealth is excluded. Verification: no claim is marked fully verified without independent sources; verdicts are a prompt to read critically, not a substitute for it.
